exercises.title: Custom State Listener
exercises.description: Simulate a lightweight custom state listener system similar to frontend reactive behavior.
exercises.context: Reactive patterns are heavily used in frameworks like React, Vue, and state management libraries.
technicalNotes: Observer patterns are common in frontend architectures.

exercises.title: Load Multiple APIs
exercises.description: Use Promise.all to load multiple asynchronous resources simultaneously.
exercises.context: Concurrent API loading is common in dashboards, analytics systems, and frontend data aggregation.
technicalNotes: Execution fails if one promise rejects.

exercises.title: Group Orders By Status
exercises.description: Group ecommerce orders dynamically using reduce.
exercises.context: Grouping data is common in dashboards, admin systems, analytics tools, and reporting platforms.
technicalNotes: Dynamic keys are useful for analytics systems.

exercises.title: Simple Event Bus
exercises.description: Build a lightweight publish/subscribe event system.
exercises.context: Event-driven systems are used in frontend architectures, game engines, and plugin systems.

exercises.title: Memoized Calculation
exercises.description: Cache expensive function results using memoization.
exercises.context: Memoization improves performance in frontend rendering, calculations, and data-heavy applications.

exercises.title: Retry Failed Requests
exercises.description: Implement a retry mechanism for unstable asynchronous requests.
exercises.context: Retry systems are common in production APIs, payment systems, and cloud services where temporary failures may occur.
technicalNotes: Retries improve reliability in unstable environments.
Error handling is essential in asynchronous systems.

exercises.title: Throttle Scroll Events
exercises.description: Limit how often a function executes using throttle logic.
exercises.context: Throttling is widely used in scroll tracking, resize listeners, and high-frequency browser events.

exercises.title: Simple Task Queue
exercises.description: Build a lightweight queue system for sequential task processing.
exercises.context: Queues are used in job systems, uploads, notifications, and asynchronous workflows.
technicalNotes: FIFO behavior is common in backend systems.

exercises.title: Paginate Product Results
exercises.description: Create a reusable pagination utility for large datasets.
exercises.context: Pagination is fundamental in ecommerce sites, dashboards, APIs, and search systems.
technicalNotes: slice helps isolate chunks of data.

exercises.title: Compose Utility Functions
exercises.description: Combine multiple functions into a reusable processing pipeline.
exercises.context: Function composition is widely used in functional programming, middleware systems, and utility libraries.

exercises.title: User Class with Methods
exercises.description: Create a User class with properties and methods for a typical application.
exercises.context: Classes are fundamental in object-oriented programming for creating reusable components and data models in applications.
technicalNotes: Classes provide a template for creating objects.
Methods define behavior on class instances.

exercises.title: Product Class with Static Method
exercises.description: Build a Product class with static methods for inventory management.
exercises.context: Static methods are used for utility functions and factory methods in class-based architectures.
technicalNotes: Static methods belong to the class, not instances.
Factory methods create instances with specific configs.
Static properties shared across all instances.

exercises.title: Binary Search Implementation
exercises.description: Implement binary search algorithm for finding elements in sorted arrays.
exercises.context: Binary search is essential for efficient lookups in sorted data, used in databases, search engines, and debugging.
technicalNotes: Time complexity is O(log n) vs O(n) for linear.
Space complexity is O(1) for iterative approach.

exercises.title: Fibonacci with Memoization
exercises.description: Optimized Fibonacci using memoization to avoid recalculating values.
exercises.context: Memoization is critical for dynamic programming problems, used in game AI, pathfinding, and optimization.
technicalNotes: Naive Fibonacci is O(2^n), memoized is O(n).
Cache stores computed results for reuse.

exercises.title: Queue Implementation
exercises.description: Implement a queue data structure using JavaScript arrays with enqueue and dequeue operations.
exercises.context: Queues are fundamental for task scheduling, BFS algorithms, message processing, and handling async operations.
technicalNotes: Array push() is O(1), shift() is O(n) - use index pointer for efficiency.
Used in breadth-first search and task queues.

exercises.title: Hash Map Implementation
exercises.description: Build a hash map with basic operations like put, get, and handle collisions.
exercises.context: Hash maps are the most common data structure for key-value storage, used in databases, caches, and language implementations.
technicalNotes: Hash functions map keys to array indices.
Chaining handles collisions with linked lists.
Average case O(1) for insert, search, delete.
